tei:div.tei:p: "!#༄༅: karma thod phreng rtsal gu ru dar nag ber chen gyi sgrub thabs bzhugs so: :

ྈྈྈ bcom ldan 'das phrin las kyi bdag po la phyag 'tshal lo:1$0000250 o rgyan padma'i gsang sgrub 'gro ba kun 'dul 'di la gsum ste: sbyor ba dang: dngos gzhi dang: rjes kyi don bstan pa'o: dang po ni sgrub rdzas bsham pa dang: rten bkod pa dang: skyabs su 'gro zhing sems bskyed bya ba'o: dang po ni: dur khrod dam brag phug tu maṇḍal sngon po kha gang gi steng du: rdo rje rgya gram ljang gu bris pa'i lte bar padma 'dab bzhi dmar po lte ba mthing gas bris pa'i lte bar gtor ma dpe'u chung ltar bsham: de'i g.yas su a mṛta: g.yon du rakta bsham: 1$0000300oṃ āḥhūm̐ 1$0000250gis byin gyis brlab: gzhan yang tshogs dang gtor ma 'byor tshad bsham: mkhar rnga dang: thod pa'i rnga dang: rkang gling dang: gsur chen gyi dud pa gtang bar bya'o: rten dgod pa ni: o rgyan phrin las sku tshab lta bu'i bris sku'am 1$0000300 1$0000250lugs sku zhig dgod: de nas skyabs 'gro bya ste: 1$0000300sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku o rgyan padma yid la byas te:1$0000250 'di skad do: 1$0000300na mo: dkon mchog gsum gyi rang bzhin bla ma la: mchog tu dad pas 'dud cing skyabs su mchi'o:1$0000250 zhes so: de nas sems bskyed pa ni: 1$0000300e ma ho: ma rtogs 'khrul pa'i sems can snying re rje: mnyam rdzogs bla ma dag gi zhing du bsgral:1$0000250 zhes tshig dang mthun par sems bskyed do: dngos gzhi la gsum ste: sa mā dhi dang: mchod pa 'bul ba dang: dbang bskur bstan pa'o: dang po 1$0000300skad cig tsam gyis bdag yi dam du gsal ba'i spyi gtsug nyi zla'i steng du: o rgyan phrin las kyi sku zhal gcig phyag gnyis skyil krung dbu gtsug rdo rje 'bar ba g.yas sa gnon rgya gram 'dzin pa: g.yon pa thod khrag bdud rtsir sdud pa: sku mdog ljang gu 'od zer 'phro ba: dar nag gi ber gsol za 'og gi phyi thul can:

brag gi ri mos brgyan pa gsal bar bsgom:1$0000250 dam tshig ye shes gnyis med bstim: snying po 'dis bsgrub par bya'o: 1$0000300oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru padma hrīṃḥkarma gu ru hūm̐:1$0000250 zhes nus stobs bskyed de bzlas pas nyams 'bar ba dang: byin 'thibs pa dang: rig rtsal che bar 'byung ngo: mchod pa 'bul ba ni: 1$0000300oṃ āḥhūm̐:1$0000250 gsum gyis mchod gtor 'dod yon lngar byin gyis brlabs te: 'di skad du spyan drangs la mchod par bya'o: 1$0000300hūm̐: sngon gyi bskal pa dang po la: dha na ko ṣa'i mtsho gling du: padma'i sdaung po ge sar la: dri med padma rgyal por 'khrungs: padma 'byung gnas chen por grags: 'khor du mkha' 'gro'i sprin phung gtibs: log 'dren gdug pa 'dul slad du: 'phags pa seng ge sgra sgrog byon: rje btsun padma gshegs su gsol: khyed kyi rjes su bdag sgrub pas: byin gyis rlob phyir gshegs su gsol: bgegs dang log 'dren bar chad sol: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru padma thod phreng rtsal: karma siddhi hūm̐ ā:1$0000250 ces snying po brgya stong du bgrang bar bya'o: de rjes dbyangs snyan pos 'di skad du mchod cing bskul te: 1$0000300hūm̐: rje btsun padma dgongs su gsol: rgya gram gur khang gzhal yas su: rdo rje 'bar ba'i gdan la bzhugs: bdag cag lus ngag yid dad pas: dad gus 'dud cing skyabs su mchi: gsang sngags 'chol bar spyad la sogs: nyams chag sdig sgrib thams cad bshags: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin dang: kun bzang mnyes mchod tshogs mchod 'bul: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru padma thod phreng rtsal sa ma ya dza: puṣpe: dhū pe: ā lo ke: gandhe: nai bidya: shabda: pū tsa ho: oṃ ma hā ba liṃ ta khā hi: āḥsarba pañtsa a mṛta kha raṃ khā hi: hūm̐ ma hā rakta khā hi: bho dhi tsitta ma hā yo gi nī khā hi:1$0000250

zhes lan gsum brjod pa'i rjes la 'di skad du: 1$0000300hrī: rje btsun padma thod phreng rtsal: phrin las mtha' ru dbyung ba'i phyir: gu ru seng ge sgra sgrog rtsal: log 'dren gdug pa tshar gcod phyir: e ma rje btsun ngo mtshar che: g.yas na pho rgyud thibs se thib: thabs kyi bdud 'dul chems se chem: g.yon na mo rgyud thibs se thib: shes rab sgron ma ya la la: mdun na dpa' bo sha ra ra: mi mthun bdud dpung thal bar rlog: slar yang bro brdungs khrigs se khrig: rgyab na chos skyong sprin ltar gtibs: sangs rgyas bstan pa'i bdud sde 'joms: slar yang gar byed shigs se shig: dpa' bo chen po hūm̐ glu sgyur: phaṭa kyi brda' skad sangs se sang: 'gro ba 'dul zhing 'gro ba 'dren: lha srin sde brgyad zil gyis gnon: bdud dang bar chad thams cad sol: 'gro don phrin las mthar phyungs shig: hrīng hrīng hrīng karma gu ru sarba siddhi hūm̐: bdud sde log 'dren thams cad sarba shā trūṃ mā ra ya phaṭa:1$0000250 ces brgya stong du bgrang ngo: dbang zhu bskur bstan pa ni: o rgyan phrin las sku 'di 'phrad pa'i skyes bu: sku de nyid rang gi spyi gtsug tu bzhugs te: rgyun sngags dang po bgrang bas: rang gi lus la ba spu g.yo ba snyam byed na: skus 'gro ba 'dul ba'i dbang thob pa yin no: de nas mgrin par bzhag ste rgyun sngags gnyis pa bgrang bas: ngag smra snying 'dod na: gsung gis 'gro ba 'dul ba'i dbang thob pa yin no: de nas rang gi snying gar bzhag ste: rgyun sngags gsum pa bzlas pas rig pa'i ngar skyes na: thugs kyis 'gro ba 'dul ba'i dbang thob pa yin no: de nas gzhan don la brtson pa rnams la: gong bzhin sku dang rten gtor dang bcas pas dbang bskur te: sngags kyi sham bu ni: 1$0000300a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: a bhi ṣiñtsa ā: a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐':1$0000250 zhes so: de nas tshogs kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po rang gi yi dam lha'i gzhung gis bskor bar bya'o:

de'i rjes la gtor ma'i phud dang: mar dang: phye dang: tshwa sbyar te skyer tsher me la bla ma yi dam bskyed: sngags gsum sham bur 1$0000300dzwa la raṃ sarba siddhi hūm̐:1$0000250 zhes pas mchod par 'bul lo: dal bsdu: smon lam gdab bo: rjes kyi don ni: sku yi bstod pa 'di sems can kun gyi rna bar bsgrag par bya'o: 1$0000300kyai: rje btsun padma thod phreng rtsal: log 'dren gdug pa 'dul ba'i phyir: bdud 'dul seng ge sgra sgrog sku: mkhar ti nag la rang byung ba: zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog ljang: phyag g.yas bdud 'dul sa la gnon: rgya gram 'bar bas phrin las sgrub: g.yon pa bde chen mnyam par gnas: rin chen thod pas dgos 'dod skong: spyi gtsug rdo rje rin chen gdugs: bstan pa mi nub rgyal mtshan 'dzugs: ljang nag drag las 'gro ba 'dul: zhabs gnyis skyil krung rdzogs sangs rgyas: mi mthun phyogs rnams zil gyis gnon: mtha' ber nag po lto dpung can: cis kyang mi 'gyur sku rab brtan: dar ber dmar phyam sku smad g.yogs: dam chos dar zhing rgyas par mdzad: sku sked stod skor 'phang los brgyan: rten 'brel sna tshogs gzhan dbang bsgyur: zhal ni thengs gcig mthong bas kyang: phyi ma lha mi dag par skye: gang zhig padma'i mtshan 'dzin cing: sku la me tog 'thor byed pa: padma can gyi zhing du skye: sngon nas bsgrubs pas las 'phror ldan: o rgyan rig 'dzin thams cad la: thugs rjes skyob cing bsten pa na: nges par bde ba can du skye: bzhi bcom drug ldan mtha' gnyis 'das: rdo rje thod phreng rtsal la bstod:1$0000250 ces skabs su bstod pa yang bya'o: o rgyan padma'i sgrub thabs 'gro ba 'dul byed ces bya ba rdzogs so: ྈྈྈ rgya: rgya: rgya: 1$0000300na mo gu ru: phyi rabs 'di 'phrad las 'phro can gyi rnal 'byor pas: 'di ltar rang gi sngon du bsgrubs te dbang rtags gong bzhin 'byung:

khyad par o rgyan nga yis dbang bskur bar byed do: las can des gang su la dbang bskur yang: o rgyan ngas dbang bskur ba dang khyad par med: gsang ba'i yang mdzod 'di ni shin tu gces so: : las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gu ru dar nag ber chen gyi bsnyen pa'i yig chung zab don snying po zhes bya ba bzhugs so// gu ru padma siddhi hūm̐/ 'dir chos dbang gi zab gter karma gu ru dar nag ber chen gyi bsnyen sgrub la 'jug par 'dod na dkyil 'khor sman gtor rakta nyer spyod tshogs 'khor sogs gzhung ltar bsham zhing*/ dkyil 'khor steng gtor ma lha tsaka 'dzugs pa'am yang na dkyil 'khor dbus su 'bur sku bkod cing mdun du gtor ma bkod la/ dkyil 'khor dbus kyi bris 'bur gyi sku rten gang yin dmigs yul du byas te gzhung ltar skyabs sems bya/ skyabs yul sku rten yin te/ de'i rgyu mtshan bla ma gsang 'dus skabs/ mdun du bla ma'i gzhal yas khang: pho brang dbus kyi sku rten nyid: rang gi re ltos bla ma dang: dus gsum bde gshegs yi dam lha: kun gyi ngo bor gyur pa la: zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ de nas rang lhar gsal ba'i spyi bor gu ru dar nag ber chen gsal btab ste/ tshig bdun ma lta bus spyan drangs la bstim/ gzi byin bskyed pa'i phyir oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru padma hrīṃḥkarma gu ru hūm̐: zhes pa 'di bsnyen pa yin pas ci nus su bzla/ bdag bskyed gtso che bar bsnyen par bshad pas/ bdag bskyed dngos yi dam gzhan yin yang spyi bor gu ru bskyed pa bdag bskyed dang don gcig /skabs der mchod gtor gzhung ltar byin gyis brlab/ hūm̐: sngon gyi bskal pa dang po la: dha na ko ṣa'i mtsho gling du: zhes sogs kyis spyan drangs pa'i ye shes de/ spyi bo'i gu ru la ye shes pa drangs bstims zin pas mdun bskyed kyi rten dam tshig pa de la bstim/

oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru padma thod phreng rtsal karma siddhi hūm̐ ā: zhes bzla ba 'di sgrub pa'o// thun bzhi'am drug gang byed kyang thun re la bsnyen sgrub kyi sngags gong 'og gnyis cha mnyam la bzla/ thun mthar/ hūm̐: rje btsun padma dgongs su gsol: zhes sogs kyis bdag bskyed spyi bo'i gu ru dang mdun bskyed gu ru gnyis thun mong du mchod cing*/ 'og nas 'byung ba'i bstod pa/ kyai: rje btsun padma thod phreng rtsal: log 'dren gdug pa 'dul ba'i phyir: zhes sogs kyis bstod/ hrī: rje btsun padma thod phreng rtsal: phrin las mtha' ru dbyung ba'i phyir: zhes sogs kyis bskul te las sbyor gyi sngags lta bur hrīng hrīng sogs nas/ mā ra ya phaṭa kyi bar ci rigs su bzla/ dbang zhu bskur skabs mdun gyi sku rten spyi bor blangs te bsnyen sngags bzla/ mgrin par bzhag ste sgrub sngags bzla/ snying gar bzhag ste las sbyor gyi sngags bzla/ 'di man gzhan don ma gtogs rang don la mi dgos/ tshogs 'khor ni karma gu ru lta bu nas len zhing*/ gtor phud kyi sbyin sreg ni gzhung gis shes so// rdzogs rim gzhung du dmigs bsal ma byung yang*/ lhag chad skong ba'i yig brgya dang bzod gsol spyi ltar bya/ mdun gyi bris 'bur gyi rten la su pra tiṣṭhas me tog gtor zhing brtan bzhugs bya/ spyi bo'i bla ma rang la bstim zhing*/ bsngo smon shis brjod spyi ltar ro// 'di yang gnas brtan rdo rje 'dzin pa dge slong ngag dbang dkon mchog gi thugs dogs sel phyir dge slong padma phrin las kyis skad cig la bris pa dge /maṅga laṃ// //
